thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: continuous-batcher backlog > 90% across rwinf-prod cluster, multiple container restarts detected. Paging on-call.

pagerduty: Triggered: CONTINUOUS_BATCHER_QUEUE_GROWTH on service=runtime, severity=high. Escalation to alice.sre.

alice.sre: ack. I'm looking. which model/route is this affecting?

maria-runtime: seeing it on redwood-gen-3-7b-quant and redwood-chat-2-13b for /v1/generate routes. Latency spike; many containers OOMing.

ken-ml: likely the continuous-batcher is letting a single batch grow unbounded due to a race with KV-cache eviction. we've seen this pattern in canary before.

alice.sre: grabbing logs from rwinf-prod-09:
```
[2026-03-15T21:07:12Z] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 1280MB
[2026-03-15T21:07:12Z] batcher: queue_length=412 max_batch_size=256 current_batch=412
[2026-03-15T21:07:13Z] container: exit_code=137 signal=SIGKILL
```

alice.sre: also showing repeated container restarts on node rwinf-prod-09 and rwinf-prod-11. memory used 97%.

maria-runtime: 99p latency for tokens jumped to ~3.2s; 5xx rate for /v1/generate is 4.7% in last 5m, impact concentrated on high-priority customers.

julia-cs: support-bot is listing affected customers, two on-calls reported production failures to CS. We need an external status if this persists.

support-bot: Affected customers: acme-inc (ids: req_3a9f, req_3b2a), beta-saas (req_4f1b). Errors: 502 + timeout 30s.

ken-ml: mitigation steps: 1) disable continuous batching for the model(s) or 2) reduce max_batch_size and max_batch_time + enable queue backpressure. quick fix is disable batching for redwood-gen-3-7b-quant.

alice.sre: I'm going to disable continuous batching on prod for that model and cordon rwinf-prod-09. Performing change now.

alice.sre: run: `POST /admin/runtime/config -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-3-7b-quant","continuous_batching":false}'` -> 200 OK

alice.sre: cordoned node rwinf-prod-09 and drained pods from it. restarting affected containers on new nodes.

gcp-bot: Autoscaler: launched 2 new instances in zone us-west2 to absorb traffic spike.

maria-runtime: routing change: traffic for model redwood-gen-3-7b-quant held to fallback variant (redwood-gen-3-7b-quant-lr) while we validate. fallback has slightly higher cost but is stable.

julia-cs: noted. Drafting a short status for customers: "We observed intermittent timeouts affecting a subset of generation requests; we applied a mitigation and are validating. No data loss. Follow-up soon."

alice.sre: memory on cluster stabilized after disabling batching. no further OOMs in last 3 minutes. 5xx rate down to 0.8%.

ken-ml: creating a bug with reproduction steps and links to logs. suspected root cause: batch growth due to missing KV-cache compaction when a request stream aborts mid-batch leading to queue-starvation on other routes.

maria-runtime: please include timeline, node IDs, and checksum of the runtime build. I'll schedule an urgent rollback of the batcher changes from the last deploy if we see repro.

nate-oncall: taking handoff in 35m. notes for next oncall: mitigations applied = batching disabled for redwood-gen-3-7b-quant; nodes cordoned: rwinf-prod-09; fallback routing active; autoscaler +2 instances. Watch 5xx and CUDA OOM alerts.

alice.sre: handoff ack. will leave temp runbook:
```
- If queue_growth > 80%: set continuous_batching=false for model
- If OOM persists: cordon node, drain pods, restart runtime, route to fallback model
- Notify CS for customers with >2 errors in 5m
```

support-bot: customers notified? julia-cs: sending now. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Reminder: submit post-incident ticket with severity and customer impact.

ken-ml: added labels: sev-high, cause-batching-growth, area-runtime. assigning to eng-runtime/maria-runtime.

maria-runtime: will open a follow-up RFC for safer batching defaults + backpressure integration. also propose a safety limit that rejects at batch_size>64.

alice.sre: final check: last_message metrics show token latency back to baseline. keeping this thread open for 30m before close.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Monitoring.

nate-oncall: taking over monitoring. thanks all. :eyes:
